**Author**: Erik Broekhuizen
**Published Date**: 2019-01-01

**Coverage**: Full PDF archived locally under reports/poten/pdfs/2019/News-Brief-16-September-2019-Attacks-on-Saudi-Oil-Infrastructure.pdf. Analysis & Overview
OPEC's Production Dilemma
13 Sep 2019: OPEC Decides to Leave Production Cuts in Place (for now) During a monitoring meeting earlier this week, OPEC decided to leave production cuts unchanged. However, Iraq and Nigeria indicated they would reduce their production to align more closely with their quotas.
